environment.description: CI/CD pipeline running on self-hosted GitHub Actions runner. The generated HTML reports are served directly from an S3 bucket configured as a public static website (bucket policy allows s3:GetObject for *). Reports are accessed by developers via direct S3 website endpoint URLs (http://build-reports-prod.s3-website-us-east-1.amazonaws.com/). No CloudFront distribution in front. The artifact_url parameter is constructed from webhook payload data including user-supplied commit messages from pull requests.
